statement.excerpt: Analyst expectations have OpenAI and Anthropic contributing at least $444 billion in revenue across hyperscalers in the next three years, and if this revenue fails to arrive — either through insolvency or renegotiation of terms — every connected hyperscaler will see massive revenue misses.

from_speaker: if this revenue fails to arrive
either through insolvency or renegotiation of terms
our_interpretation: Read the deadline as three years from publication, ending October 6, 2029.
Read 'massive revenue misses' as large shortfalls in reported revenue against analyst forecasts established before the payment failure, rather than merely slower growth or lower share prices.
The condition requires lost expected payments through insolvency or renegotiation. Concerns about future affordability do not establish it.
The surrounding passage identifies Microsoft, Google, SpaceX, Oracle and Amazon, but the complete set of connected hyperscalers and their individual forecast allocations need verification.
criteria.support_condition: After the stated payment failure occurs, every connected hyperscaler reports a large revenue shortfall against the prior analyst baseline, attributable to the lost OpenAI or Anthropic business.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying payment failure and completion of the affected reporting periods, at least one connected hyperscaler avoids a large revenue miss against the prior baseline.
